To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
UPF proteins, which promote decay of pre-mRNA and mRNA containing premature stop codons, also modulate the mRNA levels of wild-type Ctf13p and other kinetochore components.
UPF1 and UPF2 are required for rapid decay of CTF13 mRNA, and that UPF1 is required for rapid decay and for normal mRNA levels of the CTF13 gene.
the Ctf13p kinetochoresubunit is a target for nonsense-mediated mRNA decay, and this regulation is mediated by a complex of four proteins.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the regulation of gene expression and the control of chromosome transmission.
the mechanisms by which cells control the levels of specific mRNAs.
a novel function of UPF proteins, i.e., their role in regulating the expression of a gene that is required for chromosome transmission fidelity.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
UPF-mediated mRNA decay regulates the mRNA level of at least one factor that is required to promote CTF13 mRNA accumulation.
the UPF genes promote rapid turnover of nonsense mRNPs and that this function can be bypassed by increasing the steady state levels of these mRNAs.
UPF1, 2, and 3 promote decay of nonsense mRNAS, but that they also regulate the expression of the Ctf13p subunit of the yeast kinetochore.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
UPF-mediated mRNA decay is a mechanism that controls the mRNA levels of genes involved in kinetochore assembly.

UPF1 is a key regulator of CTF13 mRNA accumulation and ICK1 is a key factor in CTF13 protein accumulation, both of which are required to maintain the integrity of the Ctf13p kinetochores in S. cerevisiae.
UPF1,2,3 and ICK1 are involved in CTF mRNA accumulation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the same factors that cause rapid decay of nonsense mRNA can also cause rapid decay of a normal mRNA.
nonsense-mediated decay (NMD) is involved in the expression of CTF13 mRNA, and this is the first time NMD has been shown to play a role in the regulation of a non-nonsense gene.
nonsense mRNA decay is an essential process that can be exploited for therapeutic purposes.
